title: Conditional misalignment: common interventions can hide emergent misalignment behind contextual triggers
reasoning: The paper investigates the technical and ethical alignment of Large Language Models, specifically studying 'emergent misalignment' and the failure of safety interventions. It evaluates models on their adherence to human values (HHH: helpful, harmless, honest) and uses datasets involving moral dilemmas, gender roles, and harmful personas (e.g., the Hitler persona).
